# ACE CSCA question bank: 2000 questions

Seed 1 · built 2026-10-04 · every question verified (stmt 550, set 198, eq 219, custom 74, val 871, fn 88)

**Rule.** Each sub-domain gets total × (its items in the five real sittings ÷ 240), largest-remainder rounding. Sub-domains with no item in the five sittings get a floor of 8 questions each. 20% of each sub-domain is one notch harder than the exam (level +1); the rest is at exam level.
